<section class="resources-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="resource-grid">
      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Golf Model (3D) Repository</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          A comprehensive MATLAB-based biomechanical modeling and simulation system for analyzing golf swing dynamics, 
          trajectory optimization, and performance metrics.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Overview</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          This repository contains tools for golf swing biomechanical modeling using MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Multibody, 
          motion capture data analysis and visualization, dataset generation for swing parameter variations, interactive 
          GUI applications for visualization and analysis, performance tracking and optimization tools, and Python-based 
          utilities for data processing and visualization.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Repository Structure</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          The repository is organized into MATLAB source code and models, Python utilities, documentation, automation 
          scripts, generated results, and example implementations. Key components include Simscape Multibody models, 
          analysis and GUI scripts, interactive visualization applications, batch simulation tools, and utility functions.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Features</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          <strong>Biomechanical Modeling:</strong> Full 3D golf swing models using Simscape Multibody<br>
          <strong>Motion Analysis:</strong> Tools for processing and analyzing motion capture data<br>
          <strong>Visualization:</strong> Interactive GUI applications for swing visualization<br>
          <strong>Dataset Generation:</strong> Batch simulation tools for parameter variation studies<br>
          <strong>Python Integration:</strong> Python utilities for data processing and analysis
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">

        <p class="resource-description">

          <strong>Clone with Git:</strong><br>
          <code>git clone https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift.git</code>
        </p>
